questions: Did these movements begin suddenly, over hours or a few days?
Have you remained fully conscious and aware during the movements?
Do the movements continue while you are asleep?
Did they begin after starting or increasing any medication?
Have you taken antipsychotic medicines, metoclopramide, prochlorperazine, levodopa, or stimulant drugs?
Have you used cocaine, amphetamines, or other recreational stimulants?
Did the movements begin during pregnancy or within a year after giving birth?
Did the movements begin before you were 25 years old?
Has a biological parent, sibling, or child had similar movements?
Has a biological relative had Huntington disease, unexplained dementia, or severe psychiatric illness at a young age?
Have you developed progressive forgetfulness, personality change, depression, irritability, or impulsive behavior?
Have you developed worsening difficulty speaking, swallowing, walking, or coordinating your movements?
Have you ever had jaundice, liver disease, abnormal liver tests, or unexplained abdominal swelling?
Did you have a sore throat or suspected streptococcal infection within two months before the movements began?
Have you had fever, confusion, seizures, or a severe headache with this illness?
Have you had a rash, joint pains, mouth ulcers, sensitivity to sunlight, or another autoimmune illness?
Have you had weight loss, heat intolerance, tremor, or a persistently rapid heartbeat?
Have you recently had a stroke, head injury, or significant lack of oxygen?
Can you voluntarily suppress the movements briefly?
Do you feel an urge before the movements and relief after performing them?
